name: @fgrzl/es
description: A TypeScript port of the fgrzl/es event sourcing library.

scripts.bench: npm run bench:tier1 && npm run bench:tier2 && npm run bench:tier3
scripts.bench:tier1: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp exec vitest bench --run --reporter=default benches/tier1/*.bench.ts
scripts.bench:tier2: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp exec vitest bench --run --reporter=default benches/tier2/*.bench.ts
scripts.bench:tier3: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vp exec vitest bench --run --reporter=default benches/tier3/*.bench.ts
